name: Gladly
oneLiner: People-centered customer service platform, now positioned as an agentic commerce platform, that keeps one lifelong conversation per customer across channels and adds Gladly AI.
bestFor: Mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, including hospitality, that run high-touch service across voice and digital channels.

updates.text: Announced agentic commerce capabilities at its Gladly Connect Live conference: one AI system that handles sales questions (such as sizing) and service requests (such as exchanges) from pre-purchase discovery to post-sale retention.
Blog post describing the next version of the platform, where AI handles conversations, assists agents and resolves requests across channels.

features: One lifelong conversation thread per customer across voice, email, chat, SMS and social
Customer profile with full history and order data visible to agents
Gladly AI that answers and resolves customer requests across channels
AI assistance for human agents during conversations
Self-service help center content used by the AI
Reporting on team performance and customer satisfaction

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Gladly does not publish prices (third-party sites estimate per-user packages, unverified).

notes: Gladly's site and blog now also live at gladly.ai; the original Website link (gladly.com) was kept. Third-party price estimates (about $180-$210 per user per month, AI billed per resolved conversation) were not used because Gladly does not publish them. A third-party guide says Gladly AI hands off non-English conversations by default; not used. Vendor-reported case-study metrics left out.
